verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For Christ is of those who are humble-minded, and not of those who exalt themselves over His flock.
verses.modernizedText: For Christ is of those who are humble-minded, and not of those who exalt themselves over His flock.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Our Lord Jesus Christ, the Sceptre of the majesty of God, did not come in the pomp of pride or arrogance, although He might have done so, but in a lowly condition, as the Holy Spirit had declared regarding Him.
verses.modernizedText: Our Lord Jesus Christ, the Scepter of the majesty of God, did not come in the pomp of pride or arrogance, although He might have done so, but in a lowly condition, as the Holy Spirit had declared regarding Him.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For He says, “Lord, who hath believed our report, and to whom is the arm of the Lord revealed?
verses.modernizedText: For He says, “Lord, who has believed our report, and to whom is the arm of the Lord revealed?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: We have declared [our message] in His presence: He is, as it were, a child, and like a root in thirsty ground; He has no form nor glory, yea, we saw Him, and He had no form nor comeliness; but His form was without eminence, yea, deficient in comparison with the [ordinary] form of men.
verses.modernizedText: We have declared [our message] in His presence: He is, as it were, a child, and like a root in thirsty ground; He has no form nor glory, indeed, we saw Him, and He had no form nor comeliness; but His form was without eminence, indeed, deficient in comparison with the [ordinary] form of men.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: He is a man exposed to stripes and suffering, and acquainted with the endurance of grief: for His countenance was turned away; He was despised, and not esteemed.
verses.modernizedText: He is a man exposed to stripes and suffering, and acquainted with the endurance of grief: for His countenance was turned away; He was despised, and not esteemed.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: He bears our iniquities, and is in sorrow for our sakes; yet we supposed that [on His own account] He was exposed to labour, and stripes, and affliction.
verses.modernizedText: He bears our iniquities, and is in sorrow for our sakes; yet we supposed that [on His own account] He was exposed to labor, and stripes, and affliction.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: But He was wounded for our transgressions, and bruised for our iniquities.
verses.modernizedText: But He was wounded for our transgressions, and bruised for our iniquities.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: The chastisement of our peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we were healed.
verses.modernizedText: The chastisement of our peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we were healed.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: All we, like sheep, have gone astray; [every] man has wandered in his own way; and the Lord has delivered Him up for our sins, while He in the midst of His sufferings openeth not His mouth.
verses.modernizedText: All we, like sheep, have gone astray; [every] man has wandered in his own way; and the Lord has delivered Him up for our sins, while, in the midst of His sufferings, He does not open His mouth.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: He was brought as a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before her shearer is dumb, so He openeth not His mouth.
verses.modernizedText: He was brought as a sheep to the slaughter, and as a lamb before her shearer is silent, so He does not open His mouth.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: In His humiliation His judgment was taken away; who shall declare His generation? for His life is taken from the earth.
verses.modernizedText: In His humiliation His judgment was taken away; who shall declare His generation? for His life is taken from the earth.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For the transgressions of my people was He brought down to death.
verses.modernizedText: For the transgressions of my people was He brought down to death.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And I will give the wicked for His sepulchre, and the rich for His death, because He did no iniquity, neither was guile found in His mouth.
verses.modernizedText: And I will give the wicked for His sepulchre, and the rich for His death, because He did no iniquity, neither was guile found in His mouth.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And the Lord is pleased to purify him by stripes.
verses.modernizedText: And the Lord is pleased to purify him by stripes.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: If ye make an offering for sin, your soul shall see a long-lived seed.
verses.modernizedText: If you make an offering for sin, your soul shall see a long-lived seed.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And the Lord is pleased to relieve Him of the affliction of His soul, to show Him light, and to form Him with understanding, to justify the Just One who ministereth well to many; and He Himself shall carry their sins.
verses.modernizedText: And the Lord is pleased to relieve Him of the affliction of His soul, to show Him light, and to give Him understanding, to justify the Just One who ministers well to many; and He Himself shall carry their sins.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: On this account He shall inherit many, and shall divide the spoil of the strong; because His soul was delivered to death, and He was reckoned among the transgressors, and He bare the sins of many, and for their sins was He delivered.”
verses.modernizedText: On this account He shall inherit many, and shall divide the spoil of the strong; because His soul was delivered to death, and He was reckoned among the transgressors, and He bore the sins of many, and for their sins was He delivered.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: And again He saith, “I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.
verses.modernizedText: And again He says, “I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised of the people.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: All that see me have derided me; they have spoken with their lips; they have wagged their head, [saying] He hoped in God, let Him deliver Him, let Him save Him, since He delighteth in Him.”
verses.modernizedText: All that see me have derided me; they have spoken with their lips; they have wagged their head, [saying] He hoped in God, let Him deliver Him, let Him save Him, since He delights in Him.”

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Ye see, beloved, what is the example which has been given us; for if the Lord thus humbled Himself, what shall we do who have through Him come under the yoke of His grace?
verses.modernizedText: You see, beloved, what example has been given to us; for if the Lord thus humbled Himself, what shall we do who have through Him come under the yoke of His grace?
